Quest record

Porygon Quest: Dr. Vektor

Help Dr. Vektor remove a virus from the Digital World and unlock permanent access to the Porygon area.

Respaldado

Nivel requerido

200

Pasos

  1. 1. Accept the mission
  2. 2. Use the computer beside Dr. Vektor
  3. 3. Solve the computer-color sequence
  4. 4. Activate the final room
  5. 5. Defeat Giant Porygon
  6. 6. Return to Dr. Vektor

Recompensas

  • • 5,000,000 experience
  • • 50 Empty Alliance Ball
  • • 50 Empty Yume Ball
  • • 4 Enhanced Normal Stone
  • • Permanent access to the Porygon-area computer

Alliance PokeTibia Wiki

requirements, entry, time limit, puzzle, reward and permanent-access sections

Consultado: 2026-09-09

  • The quest requires level 200, speaking with Dr. Vektor and accepting the research task.
  • The instance is entered through the computer beside Dr. Vektor and has a 45-minute limit.
  • The final encounter is Giant Porygon; the listed rewards include experience, Empty Alliance Ball, Empty Yume Ball, Enhanced Normal Stone and permanent access to the Porygon-area computer.
